description.value: A well-kept private campground in the Slocan Valley with 17 grass-and-treed tent sites, flush washrooms, hot showers, and a covered gazebo; walking distance to the Lemon Creek confluence and a Japanese Internment Garden. Reservations require a 50% deposit to confirm.

address.value: 7680 Kennedy Rd Lemon Creek near, Slocan, BC V0G 2C0, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms this is an active campground near Winlaw with 26 sites, showers, and a covered gazebo. Phone 250-355-2547 is stated multiple times on the website but not in OSM. Reservations are clearly accepted via an online form, phone, and email. The most recent blog post dates to May 2019, raising questions about how actively maintained the site is, though the OSM record does not flag it as closed.
concerns: Website last updated May 2019; unclear if campground is still actively operating
No address available from OSM or website
Minor inconsistency on site: front page says 9 RV sites, campground subpage says 10 serviced sites
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Campground appears suitable for touring cyclists with tent sites, showers, and a covered gazebo, but the website's last update was May 2019 and no recent activity is evident. Recommend confirming it is still operating before including.

wow_evidence: 17 grass-and-treed tent sites, flush washrooms, hot showers, and a covered gazebo
